thread:
olivia: FYI: Nimble (SI) reported strange billing flips overnight. A few customers saw credits applied then removed. Looks correlated with their midnight webhook window.
marcel: Can you confirm if it's duplicate ingestion or later reconciliation reversal?
samir: Quick triage: marketplace-ingest dedupes on event_id. Nimble's SDK currently rotates event_id when a usage batch spans midnight, so same logical usage gets ingested twice with different ids. The entitlement reconcile later removes the earlier one, creating transient negative deltas.
olivia: That explains customer tickets. Any quick remediations?
samir: Short-term: change dedupe key to fallback to payload checksum when event_ids appear to be transient. I pushed a WIP branch with checksum fallback and partner-tagged logs. Example logic: ```const checksum = sha256(JSON.stringify({customer_id, window_start, value})); if (seen(event.event_id) || seen(checksum)) { /* drop */ } else { persist(); }```
marcel: Good. Add partner identifier in logs (partner=nimblesi) so metrics break down by partner. Also add metric for negative-ledger-deltas.
angela: I'll schedule a canary: deploy to 10% in us-west-2 after their next nightly push. When should I kick it?
samir: 03:10 UTC works. Deploy-bot can create the canary.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: marketplace-ingest@canary-218000  scope=us-west-2 traffic=10%
partner-success: Reached out to Nimble PMs. They acknowledged the SDK bug and can add a temporary stable `Idempotency-Key` header by EOD; full SDK fix expected next week.
olivia: Partner comms: tell them to include SDK version in the response and confirm exact times they push. We'll need that for correlation.
marcel: Action items: samir finish PR + tests (ETA 5h), angela run canary & monitor duplicate-count / negative-deltas (ETA 3h), partner-success confirm header + SDK version (ETA 2h), olivia draft rollback/backfill playbook (ETA 6h).
samir: Updated branch with partner tag and unit tests. Integration running. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-ingest/pull/438
angela: Canary live; after 20m duplicate-count for Nimble traffic dropped from ~16/hr to 2/hr. No new negative-ledger-deltas observed.
olivia: Good indicator. If stable, we should run a targeted backfill to reverse the small set of affected pairs rather than a global ledger rewrite. Keep audit logs for each reversal.
marcel: Backfill plan: only reverse when checksum matches and timestamps are within 120s, attach backfill job id and maintain audit trail. Samir, please make the backfill reversible and include a dry-run.
samir: Will open backfill PR and a short postmortem doc for partner board.
partner-success: Nimble confirmed they will add Idempotency-Key header EOD and shared SDK v1.9.2 as affected. They'll push SDK v1.9.3 with the fix next Tue.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: marketplace-ingest@canary-218000 status=success
olivia: Once Nimble headers are present and we pass one full nightly reconcile with zero new reversals, we'll mark as resolved and run the targeted backfill. I'll prepare customer-facing text for affected accounts.
marcel: Tagging follow-ups: #billing #sre #partnerships. Keep updates here with PR/backfill IDs.
